Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, then compile a comprehensive report with screenshots.

I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The site has a very clean, modern aesthetic and adapts beautifully to mobile devices. The MLB Championship Grid and Economics heatmap are exceptional features. However, there are several critical data quality issues that need attention, most notably 0% probabilities showing on the home feed, 100% resolved probabilities on the NHL grid, and rendering failures on the Weather page.

I've compiled a detailed audit report that covers all the checks requested, along with key screenshots highlighting both the failures and the pages that work well. You can review the full findings in the attached markdown report.
